en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.948 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"The minimum supplication that suffices you after the obligatory (prayers) is to say:
'O’ Allah (swt), bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. O’ Allah (swt), we ask You for every good that Your knowledge encompasses, and we seek refuge in You from every evil that Your knowledge encompasses.
O’ Allah (swt), we ask You for Your protection in all of our matters, and we seek refuge in You from the disgrace of this world and the punishment of the Hereafter.'"
